blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — While social media companies like Meta may view disinformation and misinformation as issues that can be addressed through fact-checking, Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong reminded these firms that such activities have personal consequences for their victims, affecting not only individuals but also their families. During a hearing of the House of Representatives’ Committee on Suffrage and Electoral Reforms, Alonto Adiong said he believes he is now being targeted by a disinformation campaign, referring to rumors circulating on social media about a supposedly unfinished flood control project.
